name: Naive Voxel Mesh Generation (All Faces)
aliases: Voxel Grid Mesh Generation (Explicit Quad Construction)
definition: A method to generate mesh geometry for a voxel grid by iterating through all voxels and generating quads for every face, regardless of whether the face is exposed or occluded. This is contrasted with an optimized version that only finds exposed sides.
summary: Naive Voxel Mesh Generation (All Faces) creates a mesh by explicitly generating geometry for all six voxel faces, including occluded ones, unlike optimized methods that cull internal faces.
